_about: A 30-lesson course for the variety scale test (scripts/script/scale_test.py): scripts only, never voiced or recorded. Each lesson is one short video in the owner's test business on Whop. The facts are what each section has to cover; the wording is the writer's.
course: Running your Whop business, from the first product to the first payout
